channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 04
item.description:
38 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Cows now remember being attacked, will not become passive immediately, and can kick players who get too close while fleeing.
  • Bulls now stand their ground and attack when threatened (e.g., shooting nearby) instead of continuing to graze, and they no longer turn their back when defending a cow.
  • Calves move faster to keep up with their mothers despite their small legs.
  • Newborn calves now spawn lying down and slowly get up while the mother watches.

NPC & AI

  • Cows now remember being attacked, will not become passive immediately, and can kick players who get too close while fleeing.
  • Bulls now stand their ground and attack when threatened (e.g., shooting nearby) instead of continuing to graze, and they no longer turn their back when defending a cow.
  • Calves move faster to keep up with their mothers despite their small legs.
  • Newborn calves now spawn lying down and slowly get up while the mother watches.
  • Starving animals now roam in search of food, and the drink rate has been restored, fixing fullness loss while grazing.
  • Cows now correctly idle and rest instead of constantly grazing or roaming excessively.

Weapons

  • Arrow reloading now works correctly when switching arrow types, preventing arrows from loading after the arrowhead.
  • Paintball guns now update their colour correctly when equipped.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Character creator field of view corrected, removing the overly tight perspective.
  • Store now shows a loading blocker until fully ready, preventing premature access.
  • Pressing items in the store no longer causes errors, fixing a crash/interaction bug.

Visual Fixes

  • Bee grenade viewmodel visuals are stable, eliminating drift and clipping issues.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 03
item.description:
55 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Livestock behavior overhaul: cows age, slow down, sleep, regroup at night, hunger/thirst and grazing bugs fixed, plus new sheep/lamb corpse handling and death animations.
  • Gen2 AI position update bug fixed, improving AI movement and spatial queries.

Building & Deployables

  • New sandbag barricade variants: half-height and three-quarter-height with proper collision and nav obstacles.

Combat & Weapons

  • Grenade client prediction improvements: server alignment lerp and immediate release mode bugs fixed for more reliable throws.
  • Flare throw offset reverted, adjusting throw trajectory to previous behavior.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Compactor and stove menus no longer show incorrect "Turn on"/"Turn off" options.
  • Character creator ghost figure bug fixed, preventing invisible man from appearing.
  • Animal fences now emit distinct sounds, helping players hear fence interactions.

Bug Fixes

  • Prevent crashes caused by missing particle systems in power‑grid visual effects.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Livestock now spawn with coats that can be harvested for resources and affect their appearance.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 02
item.description:
95 development commits

Livestock & Herd Management

  • Added cooldown to livestock flee trigger, improved herd regrouping radius, staggered bull flee rules, and enabled bull kick and charge to protect the herd; fixes cows not fleeing and prevents instant deceleration after attacks.
  • Fixed excessive acceleration on cows and sheep and added automated tests for bull and cow fleeing behavior.
  • Fixed null‑reference crash when a livestock animal dies.
  • Introduced overgrazing: livestock can deplete grass, halting grazing until moved to fresh grass or a trough; affected animals display a label.
  • Adjusted herd regrouping logic to reduce erratic movement after attacks.

Weapons & Projectile Prediction

  • Improved client‑side prediction for grenades and thrown weapons by using simulated positions and Rigidbody data, and added support for flares and molotov effects.
  • Fixed missing arrowheads when equipping a pre‑loaded crossbow.
  • Flare now ignites, can be thrown in third‑person view with correct spawn offset, and idle behavior is fixed.

Building & World Interactions

  • Fixed triangle hatch deployment being blocked by nearby deployables.
  • Resolved collider mismatches on monument and barrel blockers, ensuring consistent blocking and preventing players from passing through destroyed blockers.
  • Disabled shield compatibility with flashlights to avoid unintended interactions.

Server & Item Stability

  • Fixed "guid is empty" server error on first item drop and corrected efficiency upgrade size scaling.

Vehicle Controls

  • Added analogue accelerate and brake support mapped to triggers, introduced horn and seat‑swap buttons, and disabled steering while in UI.

NPC & AI

  • Critters now follow realistic sleep cycles: rabbits are crepuscular, squirrels are diurnal, and bullfrogs stay active all day.
  • Removed squirrel and rabbit interest mechanics, altering their behavior around players and objects.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Paintball guns now correctly display their custom colors in both first‑person and third‑person views.
  • Livestock animals now have proper hurt and death animations, making combat interactions clearer.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Toast notifications now correctly parse and display tokenized phrases, fixing broken messages.
  • Additional phrase handling fix restores proper display of certain toast messages.
  • Contact list notes are now saved and shown correctly, fixing missing or incorrect notes.
